preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string `s` contains only lowercase letters and digits.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == '0' and s[i+1].isdigit() for i in range(len(s)-1))
preconditions.description: No number grouping in `s` has leading zeros (i.e., no '0' followed by another digit).

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(int(''.join(c for c in group)) for group in ''.join(c if c.isdigit() else ' ' for c in s).split() if group)
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the largest number formed by any contiguous digit grouping in `s`.
